1) the overhead of reactive ad hoc routing protocols is proportional to the number of nodes in the network, 2) the overhead can be made independent of the number of nodes by controlling the distance between source and destination nodes, and 3) the overhead can also be reduced by using an appropriate routing-layer traffic pattern.
